subject: Syndicated SDK bundling — feasibility & go-to-market
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@arcplatform.co>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@arcplatform.co
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicated SDK bundling — feasibility & go-to-market

Hi Jonas,

Quick intro — I lead strategic partnerships at ArcPlatform. We embed a set of analytics and collaboration features into ISV apps and SaaS marketplaces, and a number of our customers are asking for integrated LLM features.

We are exploring a syndicated SDK bundle that would ship Redwood inference as a modular, embeddable component inside our partner ecosystem. High-level asks:
- White-labeling or co-branded distribution so partners present a unified UX
- Flexible hosting: hosted (Redwood) for starters but we may need a private/VPC option later
- Pricing tied to active seats + token ceilings; prefer simple, predictable tiers for partners
- SSO (SAML), telemetry hooks, and audit logs for enterprise customers
- A short pilot (90 days) to validate UX/perf with 50–100 customers

Can your team do a quick feasibility check and share any red flags? I attached a sketch of how we imagine the bundle (arc_proposal_outline.docx). Would love to set a discovery call next week.

Thanks — Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Partnerships, ArcPlatform
asha@arcplatform.co
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Syndicated SDK bundling — feasibility & go-to-market

Looping you in on a potential partner OEM-style bundle. ArcPlatform wants an embeddable SDK that can be hosted by us initially and optionally deployed in partner VPCs later. UX co-branding and telemetry are non-negotiable for them.

Initial technical questions:
- Integration surface: do we expose an isolatable SDK (JS + native bindings) or only server-side endpoints?
- Auth patterns: SAML SSO + token exchange for partner tenants — do we have a short path here?
- Usage fingerprinting and billing hooks: need per-tenant seat usage + token ceilings
- Privacy: can we guarantee separation for their customers in hosted mode?
- Latency & caching: their customers are latency sensitive (200–400ms targets for chat flows).

Karthik — can you run a quick perf/ops feasibility with a rough cost estimate for a 50–100 pilot (estimate peak concurrent endpoints and token throughput)? Marissa — can you draft a starter SOW (embeddable SDK + 90d pilot + co-marketing) and include a pricing sketch we can share?

I plan to propose a discovery call Monday (see Asha note).

— Jonas
Director, Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@arcplatform.co>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syndicated SDK bundling — feasibility & go-to-market

Hi Asha — great to meet the idea. Thanks for the outline.

We can definitely support an embeddable SDK approach. High-level options we recommend for the pilot:
1) Hosted bundle (fastest): Redwood hosts inference and provides an SDK that proxies requests to our endpoints. Pros: simplest for ArcPlatform, fastest time-to-value. Cons: multi-tenant billing complexity and data separation concerns which we can mitigate via tenant scoping and per-tenant encryption keys.
2) Bring-your-own-host (BYOH) later: package the runtime + orchestrator as a private stack for VPC/on-prem installs; needed for regulated customers.

Security and compliance: we can provide SAML SSO for partner admin flows, per-tenant audit logs, and key isolation through KMS. We'll need to review their SOC 2/audit requirements for BYOH.

Pricing: for the discovery call I can share a starter term sheet (attached: redwood-initial-term-sheet.pdf) with pilot pricing tied to a token ceiling + seat fees. Please send a 12-month volume forecast if available — that will let us produce a proper tiered discount schedule.

Can we do a 30-minute call Wed 08/19 at 11am PT to cover scope and timelines?

Best,
Jonas
Director, Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-initial-term-sheet.pdf
From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Syndicated SDK bundling — feasibility & go-to-market

Marissa/Karthik — quick pricing notes for the SOW draft:
- Pilot (90d): flat platform fee + token ceiling. Suggest $15k platform fee for pilot to cover dedicated logging, prefix cache warmup and sandbox infra.
- Billing model for GA: blended per-seat + per-1M token banding. Example: $0.25/seat/month + $20 per 1M tokens up to 50M then tiered discounts.
- Private deployment option: one-time packaging fee + monthly reserved capacity (estimate $8k/mo for a baseline pool that supports 4k qps sessions).

Karthik — your ops inputs on the reserved capacity estimate above would be helpful. Also flag any perf risks for low-latency chat (200–400ms).

I'll draft an embeddable-sdk-sow-draft.docx and include the pilot milestones + co-marketing commitments (ArcPlatform will feature Redwood in a partner marketplace listing if pilot metrics hit the conversion target).

— Camila
VP, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
